answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 8854 Country: India Title: Assalamualaiku Masala-e-haj Agar Aulad haj par ja rahi hai aur ma baap abhi tak hayat hain aur haj nahi kiay ahia tab kiya masla hoga agar..... 1. Waliden ya dono me se kisi ne bhi abhi tak haj na kiya ho. 2.Agar apna farz haj ada kar liya ho. 3.agar waliden hayat na ho aur ahj nahi kiya ho. 4. Agar hayat na ho aur haj kiya ho. 5. aur jo bhi condition ho Allah Hafiz Question: Assalamualaiku Masala-e-haj Agar Aulad haj par ja rahi hai aur ma baap abhi tak hayat hain aur haj nahi kiay ahia tab kiya masla hoga agar..... 1. Waliden ya dono me se kisi ne bhi abhi tak haj na kiya ho. 2.Agar apna farz haj ada kar liya ho. 3.agar waliden hayat na ho aur ahj nahi kiya ho. 4. Agar hayat na ho aur haj kiya ho. 5. aur jo bhi condition ho Allah Hafiz Answer ID: 8854 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2207/1705=H/1429) The hajj of the children is valid in every case, but if the hajj is obligatory on the parents then it is better to accompany them in hajj so that the children can have the blessing of serving parents and parents can perform their hajj easily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
